presidentMessage:
Dear CCOR Members, Colleagues, and Friends,
It is with sincere gratitude, humility, and a deep sense of responsibility that I accept the privilege of serving as your 2027 President of the Coconut Coast Organization of REALTORS® (CCOR). I am truly honored by the trust and confidence you have placed in me, and I look forward to working alongside each of you as we continue building a stronger, more connected, and forward-thinking organization.
First, I want to extend my heartfelt appreciation to our outgoing 2026 President, Jeanne Drath, for her leadership, dedication, and service to our organization. Jeanne, thank you for your commitment and for passing the gavel with a strong foundation upon which we can continue to build.
To our Past Presidents, visiting Presidents and leaders from fellow REALTOR® associations, our Board of Directors, Committee Chairs and Vice Chairs, affiliate partners, dedicated professional staff, and, most importantly, our members—thank you. Your time, talents, encouragement, and willingness to serve are what make CCOR such an exceptional organization. We stand on the shoulders of those who came before us, and our responsibility is to continue moving forward together.
As we enter 2027, my vision is simple but ambitious: to grow CCOR not only in membership, but in value, engagement, relevance, and professional excellence. I want every member to feel a genuine sense of belonging and pride in our organization and, more importantly, to become an ambassador for CCOR—sharing our mission, inviting others to participate, and helping us build meaningful connections throughout our profession and communities.
Our guiding principles for 2027 will be: Collaborate. Educate. Elevate.
Collaborate and Connect. Strong organizations are built on meaningful relationships. Our greatest strength is our membership, and every member deserves to feel connected, valued, and heard. We will work to strengthen the relationships among REALTORS®, brokers, affiliates, community partners, and fellow associations, creating a culture where ideas are welcomed, knowledge is shared, and opportunities are created. I believe that when we work together with a common purpose, we accomplish far more than any one of us could achieve alone.
Educate and Empower. Education must remain one of our highest priorities. Today's real estate professionals face an increasingly complex and rapidly changing marketplace. Our members deserve relevant, practical, and forward-thinking education that provides the knowledge, confidence, and tools necessary to succeed today while preparing for tomorrow.
But our responsibility should extend beyond the next transaction. I believe we have an extraordinary opportunity to help our members become stronger business owners and better prepared for their financial futures. Through meaningful business planning, financial literacy, technology, professional development, and long-term strategic thinking, we can provide resources that help our members build sustainable careers, create lasting financial stability, and plan confidently for themselves and their families. Our goal should not simply be to help members earn a living, but to help them build a future.
Elevate Our Profession. Together, we must continually challenge ourselves to raise the standards of professionalism, ethics, leadership, advocacy, and service. Meeting expectations is important; exceeding them should be our goal. By investing in our members, developing future leaders, embracing innovation, and strengthening the value of the REALTOR® profession, we elevate not only our organization but also the communities and consumers who place their trust in us.
I firmly believe that the true measure of CCOR's success is not simply how much our organization grows, but how positively we impact the professional and personal lives of those we serve. Our greatest accomplishments will come from listening, collaborating, mentoring one another, and creating opportunities for every member to thrive.
Leadership is never about one person or one year. It is about the people we serve, the relationships we build, and the legacy we leave for those who follow.
As your President, I pledge to lead with humility, listen with an open mind, act with integrity, and work diligently to represent the interests of our entire membership. To my fellow 2027 Board members and committee leaders, I look forward to serving alongside you. To our members, I invite you to become more engaged, share your ideas, participate in our programs, mentor others, and proudly serve as ambassadors of CCOR.
This is your organization, your voice, and your opportunity to help shape our future.
Thank you again for the extraordinary privilege of serving as your 2027 President. I am grateful for this opportunity, excited about what lies ahead, and confident in what we can accomplish together.
One Association. One Vision. Endless Possibilities.
Collaborate. Educate. Elevate.
Together, we will continue to grow, connect, lead, and elevate the future of our profession.
With sincere gratitude,
Wade H. Abed
2027 President
Coconut Coast Organization of REALTORS® (CCOR)

achievements.title: A new name for our 60th year
achievements.text: Members voted in January to adopt the Coconut Coast name. After NAR approved the change, CCOR celebrated its new identity with members and partners at the August kickoff.

achievements.title: Helping homeowners spot property fraud
achievements.text: CCOR partnered with the Lee County Clerk of Courts to promote free property fraud alerts. The association published signup instructions and materials REALTORS® can share with clients.

photos.alt: Protect Our Homes flyer from CCOR and the Lee County Clerk of Courts
photos.caption: Protect Our Homes campaign · CCOR

achievements.title: MLS collaboration tools reached members early
achievements.text: Bonita Springs–Estero was among the first MLS markets in the Realtor.com+ rollout. In June, CCOR introduced OneHomeowner through Matrix so members could share home information and stay connected with clients after closing.

photos.alt: Realtor.com+ launch graphic showing the mobile collaboration tools
photos.caption: Realtor.com+ launch announcement · CCOR

achievements.title: Open House Weekend promoted member listings
achievements.text: The March campaign gave members free consumer advertising and a public search page to help buyers find local open houses and connect with REALTORS®.
